description: This is a Perl test script for user lifecycle functionalities in a web application, including registration, email verification, login, password reset, project creation, and role management.

classes.name: Test::Coocook
classes.description: A testing helper class for web application user lifecycle testing.

methods.name: get_ok
methods.description: Performs a GET request and expects a successful response.

methods.name: register_fails_like
methods.description: Attempts registration with given data and expects failure matching a regex.

methods.name: register_ok
methods.description: Performs registration with given data and expects success.

methods.name: emails_count_is
methods.description: Checks the number of emails sent.

methods.name: email_like
methods.description: Verifies that an email matching a regex was sent.

methods.name: shift_emails
methods.description: Clears the email queue.

methods.name: login_ok
methods.description: Performs login and expects success.

methods.name: login_fails
methods.description: Performs login and expects failure.

methods.name: logout_ok
methods.description: Performs logout and expects success.

methods.name: follow_link_ok
methods.description: Follows a link with specified text and expects success.

methods.name: submit_form_ok
methods.description: Submits a form and expects success.

methods.name: content_contains
methods.description: Checks that the page content contains a string.

methods.name: change_display_name_ok
methods.description: Changes user display name and expects success.

methods.name: base_is
methods.description: Checks the current URL matches expected.

methods.name: robots_flags_ok
methods.description: Checks robots meta tags for indexing permissions.

methods.name: input_has_value
methods.description: Verifies input field value.

methods.name: checkbox_is_off
methods.description: Verifies checkbox is unchecked.

methods.name: checkbox_is_on
methods.description: Verifies checkbox is checked.

methods.name: cookie_jar
methods.description: Manages cookies for session persistence.

methods.name: create_project_ok
methods.description: Creates a project and expects success.

methods.name: base_unlike
methods.description: Checks that URL does not match a pattern.

methods.name: base_like
methods.description: Checks that URL matches a pattern.

methods.name: request_recovery_link_ok
methods.description: Requests a password recovery link and expects success.

methods.name: get_ok_email_link_like
methods.description: Finds email link matching a pattern and performs GET.

methods.name: submit_form_ok
methods.description: Submits a form with specified fields and expects success.
